algorithms.title: TECC by Phase
steps: DIRECT THREAT (hot): suppress threat / move to cover; direct self-aid; tourniquet 'high and tight' for life-threatening extremity bleeding; drag casualty to cover. No airway or spinal care.

INDIRECT THREAT (warm): M — reassess/convert TQs, pack junctional wounds, pressure dressings; A — recovery position, NPA, (surgical airway if trained); R — chest seal, needle decompression; C — IV/IO and TXA per protocol; H — hypothermia prevention, head injury care.
Move casualties to the CCP; triage there.
EVACUATION (cold): reassess everything, continue MARCH, add advanced care en route; document TQ times.

algorithms.title: Blast Casualty Rapid Check
steps: Scene: secondary device? structural collapse? fire/toxins? radiation detector alarm?
Primary: ears, breathing (blast lung), abdominal pain (bowel).
Secondary: fragment wounds — look everywhere, eyes too.
Manage: hemorrhage first, O2, cautious fluids, careful ventilation, re-triage walking patients from enclosed blasts.
